xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi:
The Company and Lenexis Foodworks Private Limited, Aayush Agrawal Trust, Inspira Foodworks Private Limited (formerly Inspira Realty 1 Private Limited) and Mr. Aayush Madhusudan Agrawal ("Allotees") have entered into a securities subscription agreement dated January 20, 2026 (SSA) and the Allottees, Inspira Agro Trading LLC (IATL) and QSR Asia Pte. Ltd. and F&B Asia Ventures (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. (Sellers) have entered into the share purchase agreement dated January 20, 2026 (SPA). Upon closing in accordance with the SPA, the Allottees and IATL will acquire control over the Company and will become the promoters of the Company and Sellers shall cease to be classified as the promoter and member of promoter group of the Company in accordance with the terms of the SSA, SPA and Regulation 31A of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
Issued and Paid-up capital as on Jun 30, 2026 comprises of following: i) 12,85,71,428 equity shares which were allotted pursuant to preferential issue. As on June 30, 2026, the listing, Corporate action and trading approval for these equity shares was pending. ii) 2,71,147 equity shares which were allotted under the Employee Stock Option Schemes (ESOPs) of the Company. As on June 30, 2026, the corporate action and listing- trading approval for these equity shares was also pending.
19,15,988 outstanding ESOP Options have been shown against the category "Employees" and 17,68,324 outstanding ESOP Options have been shown against the category "KMP".
The Company has categorized Number of employees holding shares under Employees Category basis the PAN details of the employees available with the Company.
